description: This file defines the ChargeSheetPopulator class, which is responsible for populating an Excel sheet with charge data within a bulk import process in the Apache Fineract platform. It creates and formats a sheet with charge details such as ID, name, amount, calculation type, and time type.

classes.name: ChargeSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with charge data for bulk import purposes.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates a new sheet in the workbook and populates it with charge data, then protects the sheet.

methods.name: populateCharges
methods.description: Iterates over the list of charges and writes data into the sheet rows.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Configures column widths and creates header row with titles.

methods.name: getChargesSize
methods.description: Returns the number of charges to be populated.

methods.name: getCharges
methods.description: Returns the list of charge data items.
